A particle of mass m is at rest at the origin at time t =0. It is subjected to a force $F(t) = F_{0}e^{- bt}$ in the x-direction. Its speed $v_{t}$ is depicted by which curve:
![](asset:P000284-stem-1)

assets.alt: Four graphs of velocity v(t) against time, labelled (A) to (D), each with a dashed level marked on the v-axis (F₀b/m in A, F₀/mb in B, C and D). In A and B, v rises and levels off at the dashed line; in C and D, v rises to a peak at the dashed line and falls back.
